You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From b32ca44a88def4bf92626d8777494c6f14638c42 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vivien Didelot <vivien.didelot@savoirfairelinux.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2017 14:57:21 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: lock mutex when freeing IRQs

mv88e6xxx_g2_irq_free locks the registers mutex, but not
mv88e6xxx_g1_irq_free, which results in a stack trace from
assert_reg_lock when unloading the mv88e6xxx module. Fix this.

Fixes: 3460a5770ce9 ("net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: Mask g1 interrupts and free interrupt")
Signed-off-by: Vivien Didelot <vivien.didelot@savoirfairelinux.com>
Reviewed-by: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c b/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
index 674dab71d71c..d74c7335c512 100644
--- a/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
+++ b/drivers/net/dsa/mv88e6xxx/chip.c
@@ -3951,7 +3951,9 @@ static void mv88e6xxx_remove(struct mdio_device *mdiodev)
 	if (chip->irq > 0) {
 		if (chip->info->g2_irqs > 0)
 			mv88e6xxx_g2_irq_free(chip);
+		mutex_lock(&chip->reg_lock);
 		mv88e6xxx_g1_irq_free(chip);
+		mutex_unlock(&chip->reg_lock);
 	}
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the `mv88e6xxx_g1_irq_free` function not acquiring the necessary mutex lock (`reg_lock`) before accessing shared resources, leading to a race condition when unloading the `mv88e6xxx` module. This resulted in an assertion failure in `assert_reg_lock`, which checks if the mutex is held when accessing the registers. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the mutex is locked before calling `mv88e6xxx_g1_irq_free`, thus preventing concurrent access issues.
